purpose: Preserve save-boundary failure evidence outside frozen HDS without live execution or changing normal save semantics.
observation: Historical transformed save/standard pretry deadline/mkdir failures bypass local capture; compute reentry can fail after successful durable output and pending clearance. Resource writer already has pre/post guards.
cause: try/finally boundaries do not include all entry/exit operations; result becomes unavailable to ordinary caller when finally raises.
change: New caller-side SaveCapture delegates exact pinned own save/standard functions. On failure: stop original timer, retain prior/current/attempted pending object references, inspect only matching own method code+receiver, recover completed result/FileRef, bound existing output observation and guarded diagnostic sink by existing failure120 budget, stop finally and rethrow same primary exception. No monkey-patch or launcher.

previous.target_faults: missing method exception entry and lost returned receipt; standard mkdir can leave save timer active
previous.normal_save: exact inherited source AST with full pre-save scan

current.target_faults: durable diagnostic in permitted fixture budget; exact pending/partial/completed evidence retained; timer stopped; same exception rethrown
current.normal_save: same bytes/hash, typed order, full scans, open/fsync/clock call sequence

delta.new_failure_capture: target3 fault positions, standard/journal variants, no-clobber and secondary failure evidence

regression.HOLD: same exception propagation and inert HOLD packet bytes; existing outer HOLD/latch not executed or replaced

initial_material_findings: unbounded output observation/FIFO blocking after timer stop
capture bookkeeping could replace primary exception
review.disposition: corrected and tested; independent reviewer recheck found no further material blocker for NOT_ADOPTED pure-fixture retention

failed_tests_retained.reason: new test scaffold named nonexistent fixture method; no new adapter test reached execution

limitations: NOT_ADOPTED: current/fresh043 binding missing; no actual native codec or HDS persistence tested.
Durable capture is conditional on available existing failure time/space and working I/O; failure under capture exhaustion stays in memory and original exception propagates.
Capture allocation/bookkeeping exhaustion can prevent new record creation; primary propagation and stop are best effort, not a guarantee under kernel/process failure.
Diagnostic output written during failure timer; final stop is observed only after unwind in test evidence, not claimed by the diagnostic before it finishes writing.
Timer stop itself can fail; this is retained without a false stopped claim.
Signals/time and high accounting limits use deterministic test doubles; no real asynchronous-signal or power-loss guarantee.
Existing output is read O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK as a regular bounded file; ancestor namespace race confinement not proven.

The prototype takes a caller-supplied failure sink; only the tested sink binding enforces original incremental failure4MiB plus resource pre/post guards/exclusive write. No arbitrary sink certification.
Sink failure can leave unreceipted diagnostic bytes; bytes are not removed, no receipt is claimed, and test evidence preserves their full bytes/hash.
No persistent native HOLD latch is supplied; existing outer HOLD must remain authoritative for adoption. No auto-retry or follow-on native operation is made.
Other historical weaknesses, including lack of inherited postguard, are not changed or declared fixed.
